name: arcgis-rest
description: Call ArcGIS REST endpoints directly from agent scripts: portal search and items, feature layer queries, geocoding, routing, places, elevation and GeoEnrichment, as the signed-in portal user. Also local GIS sources, standalone ArcGIS Maps SDK maps and the live mappi map over MCP.

mappi.description: Live map (mappi), present only while its server runs; read the mappi skill before the first call. Runs map JS in the open ArcGIS Maps SDK page
